contract: ADR 131, NR-04 ordinary explicit Goal admission, read with ADRs 35, 41, 55, 65, 116 and 129–130.

baseline.surface: Actual old Bun CLI and extracted featureless native arm64 CLI, same explicit goal mode, full access, loopback model emits write_file with no persisted plan.

admission: No plan: write_file, bash and its matching PreToolUse Hook are not dispatched; an actual read succeeds, with original denied Grant, Tool Result and Evidence preserved.

Canonical plan bound to the same conversation and actual workspace permits a Full-authorized write. Other conversation, other workspace, awaiting approval, rejected, runner-paused and delegated records cannot grant admission.

A real PTY denial stops a write even with an accepted plan. A real PTY approval after the accepted plan pauses still yields a denied Tool Grant and no workspace effect. Both user decisions are preserved in ApprovalStore.

limits: Isolated source and fixture data. The candidate restores effect admission for existing canonical plans. The public Goal create, update, query and Explorer execution paths, existing installed-host stop, production model and full P4 acceptance remain open.
